name: Hoshimi Ren Japanese v2
prompt: An original young adult Japanese female voice around age twenty, speaking native standard Japanese. Bright, fresh, youthful girlish higher-mid register with feather-light vocal weight and a translucent, spring-water purity — distinctly young, sweet, and maidenly rather than a deep or mature older woman's voice. Graceful Yamato-nadeshiko gentleness, soft airy warmth, neat and attentive articulation.
